title: Onboard Aurora-XK 13B v1.1: perf profiles + changelog automation
author: Priya Nair
description: Onboard Aurora-XK 13B v1.1 to the model registry with performance profiles and automated changelog generation. Motivation: Aurora-XK v1.1 introduces improved attention fusion and a new quantization-friendly checkpoint layout; we need up-to-date metadata, validated perf profiles for our target instance types, and automated release notes so customer-facing changelogs reflect perf regressions/improvements automatically. This PR includes: 1) metadata files (model.yaml, manifest) with canonical model id, aliases, and versioning fields; 2) performance profiles for GPUNode-A100-40GB and T4-burst that include throughput, latency p50/p95, and memory working set; 3) quantization profile recommendations and a default quantization tag for v1.1; 4) updates to the changelog automation pipeline so onboarding events append a structured entry and emit a human-friendly release note; 5) small fix to the perf-runner to normalize sequence length buckets used for profiling. Testing: profiled on internal perf lab (see perf-ci run), added unit tests for manifest schema and changelog writer. Backwards-compatible with existing registry consumers. See rollout notes/QA steps below.
